== Ingredients ==
* 1 center-cut [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] tenderloin roast
* [[Cookbook:Cognac|Cognac]], as needed
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] soaked mesquite wood chips
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 Tbsp coarsely-ground [[Cookbook:Coriander|coriander]] seeds
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] salt
* 1 ½ tsp coarsely-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 ½ tsp dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 2 tsp dehydrated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] peel

== Procedure ==
#Place beef in a large zip-top plastic bag. Add cognac to cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
#Place mesquite chips in the hot coal area of a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]].
#Combine paprika, coriander, salt, pepper, rosemary, and lemon peel. Rub this mixture all over beef and bring to room temperature.
#Place beef in center of grill, cover, and cook, turning often until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare, 150°F for medium, or 160°F for toast.
#Remove, let rest for 10 minutes, and serve.
